notes: The motion check and the block-start set check no longer move on a single glitched frame — both are now sustained ranges, confirmed by at least two frames, like the rest of the classic engine's numbers already are. One frame misreading a hip wide used to unlock the analyzer on a still clip and to throw out a valid block start whose set was still. A real run moves the hips on every frame and a real set holds still on every frame, so both still read true.
